Generates C code for Solana type serialization, deserialization, size, and reflection.

# Purpose
This script generates C source files for the Solana/Firedancer type system from the `fd_types.json` configuration file. It reads type definitions, builds an internal model for structs, enums, opaque types, arrays, vectors, maps, deques, treaps, options, and other member forms, then writes a header file, an implementation file, and a reflection file. The generated code provides serialization and deserialization with bincode, memory size calculation, type walking for reflection, and support for both normal and global forms of types that use offsets instead of direct pointers.

The file acts as a code generator, not as a runtime library. Its main logic is in the `TypeNode` hierarchy and the `main()` function. The type classes emit C declarations and function bodies for each configured type, including constructors, encode and decode functions, size functions, and walk functions. The script also propagates the `global` property through dependent types, builds a type lookup table, and emits reflection metadata in `fd_types_vt_list` so other code can inspect the generated types at runtime.
